sections.name: Spine
sections.say: It opens your spine and undoes the slouch.

clips.shot: Side view, cobra stretch on a black mat: lying face down, hands under the shoulders, chest lifted, arms straight, hips on the mat, long arched spine; the spinal erectors and abs glow. Figure in the lower-middle of the frame
clips.move: a cobra stretch, the chest slowly rising and lowering with each breath

cues: Do this instead: the cobra stretch.
It opens your spine and undoes the slouch.
